+"""Merge fallback layers into a base document."""
+
+from lamina.model import Document
+
+
+def merge_fallback(base, overlay, *, create=True, skip=None):
+    """Return base with overlay's values applied, keeping base's order, comments and blank lines."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(overlay.source)
+    merged_doc = base.copy()
+    for section in overlay.sections():
+        target = merged_doc.section(section.name, create=create)
+        if target is None:
+            continue
+        for entry in section.entries():
+            target.set(entry.key, entry.value)
+    return merged_doc

+from lamina.loader import loads
+from lamina.model.fallback import merge_fallback
+
+
+def test_fallback_overrides():
+    doc = merge_fallback(loads("[a]\nx = 1\n"), loads("[a]\nx = 2\n"))
+    assert doc.get("a.x") == "2"
+
+
+def test_fallback_no_create():
+    doc = merge_fallback(loads("[a]\nx = 1\n"), loads("[b]\ny = 2\n"), create=False)
+    assert doc.section("b") is None
